def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Remove exact duplicate rows (2 duplicated orders)
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # Normalize Category labels (strip extra spaces/leading spaces)
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].astype(str).str.strip()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    counts = df.groupby('Category').size()
    return {str(k): int(v) for k, v in counts.items()}
